pages.text: The fern flower blooms in the dense forest and glows in the dusk. Pick it and raise it to the sky (right-click the air): every ore and chest within 16 blocks sparkles, and luck comes to you.

The self-laying tablecloth lays itself with a feast once a day. The self-playing gusli set every monster around dancing: for 8 seconds they forget whom they were after. Look for them at shrines and in Koschei's castle.
Baba Yaga sells the guiding yarn ball. Drop it (right-click): it rolls toward the lair of the nearest foe you have not beaten yet, and leaves a golden trail.
